changelog:
- Initial release of the "Time as Aesthetic Subject — Cross-Domain" skill.
- Provides cross-domain aesthetic guidance focused on making time visible in painting, poetry, philosophy, and literature.
- Includes curated style tokens and anti-tokens to define accepted and excluded aesthetic patterns.
- Features exemplars from Holbein, Keats, and Ecclesiastes to illustrate the approach.
- Offers targeted application advice for writing, UI design, and branding.
- Defines evaluation criteria to guide effective use of the skill.
- Live demo available for instant testing without the need for an account.
summary: Analyzes works to reveal time as a visible, material presence in art and literature, showing mortality and transience without nostalgia or sentimentality.
